title: Loopback publish except 9096
scope: Synthetic compose fixtures written into temporary roots and audited by the actual gate. No Docker Compose evaluation, service launch or port binding; no fixture asserts anything about a deployed service.

implemented.parser: scripts/ci/check-ports-loopback.mjs carries a strict YAML reader for the compose subset: block mappings and sequences, flow mappings and sequences (so JSON parses for free, including a multi-line whole-document JSON file), single/double-quoted scalars, block scalars, multiple documents, anchors, aliases and merge keys. Anything outside that subset (tags, tabs in indentation, unterminated flow collections, undefined aliases) is REJECTED with a file and line, never skipped.
implemented.normalisation: Every ports entry — short syntax, long syntax block or inline flow — is normalised to {host_ip, published, target, protocol}. Long syntax is judged on the same tuple rather than banned by spelling.
implemented.sanctioned_list: Restructured from raw strings to explicit tuples matched semantically, so a sanction cannot be smuggled by re-spelling, does not transfer between compose files, and a different target port is a different door.
still_rejected: a ports value that is not a sequence
implemented.entry_point: scripts/ci/check-ports-loopback.sh remains the CI entry point and execs the .mjs; a copy of the wrapper without its gate exits 3 with an explicit message rather than looking like a pass (asserted).

reproduced_bypass_now_closed: A public port written as a nested service-flow mapping or as JSON-flow passed the previous awk line-walker because it only armed on a line whose first token was `ports:`. All six spellings of the same door are now rejected.

limitations: The gate audits the compose SOURCE files matched by the root glob. It does not resolve overlay order, --env-file interpolation, `extends`, `include:` or files outside the repository root, and certifies nothing about a running deployment. A pass means the checked-in files declare no unsanctioned door.
